name: Sanjeev Kapoor
bio: One of India’s best-known TV chefs (Khana Khazana), with a huge library of everyday vegetarian dishes.

name: Ranveer Brar
bio: Chef and TV host who explains the technique and stories behind North Indian classics like rajma and dal makhani.

name: Kunal Kapur
bio: Chef and former MasterChef India judge: restaurant-style paneer, dal and lighter high-protein vegetarian meals.

name: Nisha Madhulika
bio: Home-style North Indian vegetarian cooking in Hindi, explained step by step.

name: Hebbar’s Kitchen
bio: Archana Hebbar’s quick, no-talk vegetarian recipes from across South and North India.

name: Your Food Lab (Sanjyot Keer)
bio: Street-style and high-protein vegetarian recipes with a Mumbai flavor.

name: Harpal Singh Sokhi
bio: Cheerful chef known for Punjabi and street-food vegetarian dishes.

name: Manjula’s Kitchen
bio: Manjula Jain’s fully vegetarian recipes, many with no onion or garlic.

name: Tarla Dalal
bio: Legendary vegetarian cookbook author; her team keeps a huge vegetarian recipe archive.

name: Vikas Khanna
bio: Michelin-starred chef celebrated for regional Indian vegetarian classics.

name: Pankaj Bhadouria
bio: Winner of MasterChef India season 1, cooking simple, everyday vegetarian home meals.

name: Maangchi
bio: Korean home cooking, including tofu, kimchi and noodle dishes.

name: Chinese Cooking Demystified
bio: Authentic Chinese technique explained clearly, from mapo tofu to smashed cucumber.

name: Just One Cookbook
bio: Namiko Chen’s Japanese home cooking: donburi, miso soup and more.

name: Pailin’s Kitchen
bio: Pailin Chongchitnant’s Thai cooking, including curries and stir-fries.

name: Rick Bayless
bio: Chef and Mexican-food authority: salsas, beans, tortillas and more.

name: The Mediterranean Dish
bio: Suzy Karadsheh’s Mediterranean recipes: falafel, hummus, lentils and grain bowls.

name: Vincenzo’s Plate
bio: Italian home cooking: pasta, sauces and simple classics.

name: Rainbow Plant Life
bio: Nisha Vora’s vegan cooking, with many protein-rich bowls, curries and bakes.

name: Simnett Nutrition
bio: Derek Simnett on building muscle with plant-based meals and training.
